stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS via College Navigator (fall 2024 entering class); no readable Common Data Set: Millersville's CDS page says its PDFs were taken offline for accessibility and must be requested from ir@millersville.edu. College Navigator prints only rounded percentages (86% admitted, 18% of admitted enrolled), so admits and enrolled counts are left null. International applicant counts, GPA and class-rank splits are not available. SAT percentiles are from the 221 enrolled first-years who submitted SAT (18%); ACT percentiles are not published. Undergraduate enrollment and student-faculty ratio (19 to 1) are College Navigator figures. Applicant/admit/enrolled counts replaced with exact IPEDS ADM2023 (fall 2023) figures, because the newer source gives only a rounded admit rate.

cost.notes: College Navigator estimated expenses 2024-2025 (tuition and fees; on-campus food and housing). Superseded for international students by the cycle-file international cost.
